cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Merciful Lie
cards.instruction: Choose a truth your character believes would hurt someone. Keep it from them, even as honesty becomes harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The bakery assessed your cake in the wrong category. This is display work; put the knife away.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They wrote 'inedible.' I thought I'd finally made something worth selling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Display pieces aren't sliced. I'll prepare a card naming the materials and giving the price.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take it in and ask them to taste it while they read your card.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No tasting. We have just established the category. Give me the knife; I'll speak to them myself.

reason: Make the merciful lie a sustained display-specialist reclassification; B request for a real tasting threatens the lie and causes A increasingly strained intervention.
